descriptionEn: Offered for sale: an apartment with an area of 99m², located on Rruga Gjergj Fishta, in the Linda 5 building, built by the company AlTrade.
The apartment is on the 4th floor, faces East and the building has two elevators.

The space consists of a living room with kitchen and dining area, three bedrooms, one bathroom, one WC and two terraces.
The apartment has underfloor heating, air conditioning and a kitchen equipped with appliances from the Gorenje brand.

The property has an ownership certificate, while the sale contract is signed at the notary.
A private garage is also offered for sale separately from the price of the apartment.

notes: Developer AlTrade is explicitly named ("ndërtim nga kompania AlTrade"). Total €96,030 = 99 m² × €970 as stated in the caption. Garage is sold separately (garageOptional), so 'garage' is not in features. Two terraces stated; areaTerrace not given. No images excluded.
